1. Best Performing Creative Themes

“All-In-One POS” messaging consistently drives high SQL% and scalability, with low CPL and CPSQL — proving that product-focused, value-driven messages perform best.

Creatives that highlight “#1 POS System” with promo as supporting point perfom better than logos as supporting point.

The CTR% for these ads was usually lower than average.

2. Underperforming Creative Elements

- Hardware + merchant quotes/logos/testimonials underperformed — they result in high CPL and low Win%.

- Creatives with Testimonials didn’t scale — despite decent engagement, they failed to get SQLs or Wins (high CPWon).

3. Strong Creative Drivers

Promotional hooks (e.g., “₱63 software,” “₱21,000 off”) significantly improve SQL% — discount-led offers work well as acquisition triggers.

4. Creative Optimization Insights

Test more ads with CTA buttons + hardware to improve engagement without losing clarity of the main offering.
